rule: No HOO-era code, logic, content or assets. HOO = Heroes of Old, AO20's next-generation client (ao-org/hoo-dependencies, the hoo-* branches of argentum-online-client-classic). Every upstream is pinned to its last commit before HOO work landed; anything newer needs an explicit, documented exception.
